channels.title: Virtual receptionist channels
channels.subtitle: Connect Facebook Messenger, Instagram and Telegram to answer customers in their favourite channel.
channels.whatsappDescription: Messages routed through the already-connected WhatsApp pipeline. Always on.
channels.metaDescription: Messenger and Instagram DMs share a single Meta connection (pageId + accessToken). The salon must have a Facebook Page.
channels.telegramDescription: Telegram Bot API. Only the bot token is needed (from @BotFather /newbot). No Meta dependency.
channels.scopeNotice: Credentials are stored encrypted and only visible to the system and the support team.
channels.webhookUrlHint: Paste this URL into the Webhook configuration of your Meta App.
channels.telegramWebhookHint: Paste this URL into your bot settings via @BotFather (/setwebhook) and use the bot token as the secret.
channels.metaWizardIntro: You need a Meta Business account to use Messenger and Instagram DMs. Follow the 4 steps:
channels.metaStep1: Create a Facebook Page for your salon if you don't have one yet.
channels.metaStep2: Convert your Instagram account to a Professional or Business account.
channels.metaStep3: Link your Instagram Business to the Facebook Page: Instagram -> Settings -> Account -> Linked accounts -> Facebook -> Connect.
channels.metaStep4Hint: Find them at developers.facebook.com -> Your App -> Products -> Messenger -> Settings.
channels.metaPageIdHelp: Numeric identifier of the Facebook Page. 6-32 digits.
channels.metaAccessTokenHelp: Long-lived token (EAA...). Only shown once when generated.
channels.metaAccessTokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token.
channels.metaIgBusinessIdHelp: If your IG Business account is already linked, paste the numeric ID here.
channels.metaWebhookSecretHelp: Random string Meta sends in X-Hub-Signature-256 to verify the origin.
channels.telegramWizardIntro: Create a bot with @BotFather in under a minute. You only need the token.
channels.telegramStep3: Assign a public name and a username ending in 'bot' (e.g. my_salon_bot).
channels.telegramStep4: Copy the token BotFather returns and paste it below.
channels.telegramTokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token.
channels.telegramTokenFormat: The format doesn't look right. It should be <id>:<35+ characters>.
channels.upgradeRequiredTitle: Multichannel not included in your plan
channels.upgradeRequiredMessage: Your Esencial plan only includes the in-app web chat. Upgrade to Pro or Empresa to connect Messenger, Instagram and Telegram.
channels.upgradeBulletFb: Facebook Messenger with a single Meta assistant
channels.upgradeBulletTg: Telegram via Bot API (no per-message cost)
channels.upgradeHelp: The plan change is immediate. Your existing credentials are preserved.
channels.buyAddonHelp: Activates immediately. You keep your Esencial plan (€49/month). Cancel the add-on from the billing dashboard.

platform_llm.title: Chatbot AI provider
platform_llm.subtitle: Configure the model and API key used by the Virtual Assistant to answer clients of all salons. This is a global setting and is NOT visible to salon owners.
platform_llm.model_recommended: Recommended: claude-haiku-4-5 (fast and cheap for chatbot).
platform_llm.api_key_no_key: No API key configured. The chatbot will fall back to the server env var (if set).
platform_llm.base_url_placeholder: https://api.anthropic.com  (leave blank to use the official one)
platform_llm.base_url_help: Only needed for Anthropic-API-compatible providers (e.g. MiniMax, internal proxies).
platform_llm.workspace_id_help: If your API key was created in console.anthropic.com after October 2025, it is "identity-linked" and requires this UUID. Find it in Settings → API Keys, "Workspace" column. Leave blank if using a classic key.
platform_llm.save_success_with_key: Changes apply on the next chatbot message.
platform_llm.save_success_no_key: Configuration saved. Enter an API key to activate the provider.
platform_llm.security_notice: The API key is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM (EncryptionService) and is never returned by the API. It is only decrypted in memory briefly when calling the provider. Changes to the API key take effect on the next chatbot message (no backend restart required).
